row.body: A keyring is fastened beneath the clipboard clip. Its tag is worn smooth; the page above it has two pencil holes and no writing.
row.title: The clipboard held the only spare

sidecar.gloss: An access key is attached to a page that was never filled in.
sidecar.rival_reading: A field courier could secure a site key to a blank clipboard before a handoff; the empty page does not prove anyone was left without instructions.

row.body: the baling twine and hand torch smell sharply of bleach. mud outlines between them show that a third object was removed.
row.title: missing count beside the baling twine

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
